title: CHAPTER VIII. Anne's Bringing-up Is Begun
chineseTitle: 第 8 章：安妮的教养生活开始了

paragraphs.en: Marilla kept Anne busy with chores in the morning, closely watching her. By noon, Marilla concluded that Anne was smart and willing to work, though she sometimes daydreamed.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉早上让安妮忙于家务，严密监督着她。到中午时分，玛丽拉认为安妮聪明且愿意干活，只是偶尔会走神。

paragraphs.en: When Anne finished washing dishes, she confronted Marilla, trembling and flushed, her eyes wide. "Please, Miss Cuthbert," she pleaded, "will you tell me if you're going to send me away? I've tried to be patient but can't bear not knowing."
paragraphs.zh: 当安妮洗完餐具，她颤抖着走上前去，脸颊泛红，眼睛睁得大大的。她恳求着说：“库伯特小姐，请您告诉我，您是不是真的要送我走？我已经尽力忍耐了，但实在无法忍受这种不确定性。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla replied, "You didn't scald the dishcloth in clean hot water as I told you." Anne went to do it and returned, imploring Marilla. "Well," said Marilla, deciding to explain, "Matthew and I have decided to keep you if you're good and show gratitude."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回答说：“你没有按照我说的，把抹布放在干净的热水里烫一下。”安妮听了后又去做了，并央求玛丽拉：“好吧，”玛丽拉决定解释一下，“如果我们觉得你表现得好，会考虑收留你，并且教你懂得感恩。”

paragraphs.en: Anne was confused, saying she was crying but didn't know why. She expressed her happiness, feeling more than glad. "I'll try my best," she promised, wondering about the reason for her tears.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮感到困惑，她哭着说却不知道原因。她表达了内心的喜悦，感觉高兴得不止如此。“我会尽力而为的，”她承诺道，心里疑惑着自己为何会流泪。

paragraphs.en: Marilla disapproved, saying Anne was too excited. "Sit down and calm yourself," she advised. "You cry and laugh too easily."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉表示反对，说安妮太激动了。“坐下，冷静一下。”她建议道，“你哭笑得太容易了。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla agreed Anne could stay but insisted on attending school only when it reopened in September.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉同意安妮可以留下，但坚持要求她在九月开学时才能返校上课。

paragraphs.en: "Should I call you Miss Cuthbert?" asked Anne. "Can I call you Aunt Marilla?"
paragraphs.zh: “我该叫你库伯特小姐吗？”安妮问道，“我能叫你玛丽拉阿姨吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No, just Marilla," replied Marilla. "It would make me nervous."
paragraphs.zh: “不，就叫玛丽拉吧，”玛丽拉回答道，“这样我会感到不安的。”

paragraphs.en: "It sounds disrespectful to say Marilla," protested Anne.
paragraphs.zh: “说玛丽拉不敬似乎不对，”安妮抗议道。

paragraphs.en: "I'll be careful to speak respectfully," assured Anne. "Everyone in Avonlea calls me Marilla except the minister."
paragraphs.zh: “我一定会小心说话，表现出应有的尊敬，”安妮保证说，“除了牧师，埃文利镇上的人都叫我玛丽拉。”

paragraphs.en: Anne wished she could call Marilla Aunt Marilla. "I've never had an aunt or any relation—no grandmother either," she said wistfully. "Can't I call you Aunt Marilla?"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮多希望能称呼玛丽拉为姑妈玛莉拉。“我从未有过阿姨或任何亲戚——也没有祖母，”她满怀渴望地说，“难道不能叫我姑妈玛莉拉吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No, and don’t use names that don’t fit," Marilla replied sternly.
paragraphs.zh: “不行，也不要用不合适的名字,”玛丽拉严肃地说道。

paragraphs.en: "Do you ever imagine things differently?" asked Anne curiously.
paragraphs.zh: “你有没有想过事情会有所不同？”安妮好奇地问道。

paragraphs.en: "No."
paragraphs.zh: “不，”安妮摇了摇头。

paragraphs.en: "Then how much you miss!" sighed Anne.
paragraphs.zh: “那你一定很怀念吧！”安妮叹了口气。

paragraphs.en: Marilla retorted, "I don't imagine things. The Lord placed us in certain circumstances." She instructed Anne to clean her feet and bring the illustrated card with the Lord's Prayer for memorization that afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉反驳说：“我可没胡思乱想。上帝把我们安排在了特定的境况中。”她吩咐安妮擦干净脚，并且带一本配有《主祷文》插图的卡片，以便下午用来背诵记忆。

paragraphs.en: Anne admitted she was awkward but explained it was her first time praying. She had crafted a long, poetic prayer last night but couldn't remember any words in the morning.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮承认自己不太熟练，但她解释说这是她第一次祈祷。昨晚她精心构思了一篇长而富有诗意的祷文，但早上却怎么也记不起来了。

paragraphs.en: Marilla instructed Anne to follow orders without delay. Anne promptly went to the sitting-room across the hall and didn't return. After ten minutes, Marilla stopped knitting and searched for her.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉吩咐安妮立刻遵照命令行事。安妮当即去了对面厅里的起坐间，并没有回来。十分钟后，玛丽拉放下手中的活计，四处寻找她。

paragraphs.en: She found Anne standing still before a picture between two windows, lost in dreams. The light from outside cast a half-unearthly glow on Anne's rapt figure.
paragraphs.zh: 她发现安妮站在两扇窗户之间的画前，沉浸在梦幻中。窗外的光线在她专注的身影上洒下了一层半真半幻的光晕。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, what are you thinking about?" Marilla asked sharply.
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，你在想什么呢？”玛丽拉尖锐地问道。

paragraphs.en: Startled, Anne returned to reality.
paragraphs.zh: 受惊之后，安妮回到了现实世界。

paragraphs.en: Anne pointed to a picture—a vivid chromo titled "Christ Blessing Little Children." She imagined herself as one of the children, standing alone in the corner. "She looks lonely," Anne said, "and I think she had no parents but still wanted to be blessed."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮指着一幅图画——一幅名为“基督祝福孩童”的鲜艳彩绘。她想象自己就是其中一个孩子，独自站在角落里。“她看起来好孤单啊，”安妮说，“我觉得她没有父母，却仍然渴望得到祝福。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla interrupted, puzzled by Anne's lengthy musings: "You shouldn't talk like that; it’s irreverent."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉插话道，她对安妮冗长的沉思感到困惑：“你不要那样说话；这是不敬。”

paragraphs.en: Anne defended her thoughts, saying, "I felt reverent. I didn’t mean to be irreverent."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮为自己辩护道：“我感到十分敬畏，并没有故意不敬。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla explained, "It just doesn’t sound right to speak so familiarly about such matters. And when you’re sent for something, bring it back immediately without getting lost in daydreams before pictures."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉解释说：“这样随便说话不太合适，毕竟这些事情还是正式点好。你去拿东西的时候，一定要立刻回来，不要被那些画面勾走了心思。”

paragraphs.en: Anne placed the card among some apple blossoms she had brought to decorate the dinner table. Marilla had noticed but said nothing. Anne then propped her chin on her hands and studied the card intently for several minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮把那张卡片放在了一些她带来的苹果花中，用来装饰晚餐桌子。玛丽拉注意到了，但没有说什么。随后，安妮托起下巴，双手支着头，仔细端详了那张卡片好几分钟。

paragraphs.en: Anne declared she liked the prayer they were learning. "It's beautiful," she said, recalling hearing it in an asylum Sunday school but disliking it then due to the preacher’s mournful tone. Now, however, it felt like poetry.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮宣称她喜欢他们正在学习的祈祷文。“真美，”她说，回忆起曾在一所疗养院星期日学校听过它，但当时因为传教士悲伤的语气而不喜欢。然而现在，它听起来像是一首诗。

paragraphs.en: Marilla responded curtly, instructing Anne to learn and be quiet.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉冷冰冰地回应，命令安妮学会闭嘴。

paragraphs.en: Anne continued studying, then asked Marilla if she might have a bosom friend in Avonlea. She described her ideal friend as an intimate companion who could understand her deeply. Many of her dreams had come true recently, so perhaps this one would too.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮继续学习，随后问玛丽拉是否可以拥有一位埃文利的好友。她描述心中的理想好友是一位能够深刻理解她的亲密伴侣。最近她的许多梦想都实现了，或许这个愿望也会成真。

paragraphs.en: Marilla mentioned Diana Barry from Orchard Slope, about Anne’s age and a nice girl, but warned Anne to behave well since Mrs. Barry was particular. Diana visited her aunt in Carmody at the moment.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉提到奥尔德里奇坡的戴安娜·巴里，说她和安妮年纪相仿，是个不错的女孩，但警告安妮要表现得体些，因为巴里太太对人很挑剔。当时戴安娜正在卡姆多伊拜访她的姑妈。

paragraphs.en: Anne looked through apple blossoms, eager for details on Diana. She hoped Diana did not have red hair like hers. Marilla described Diana as pretty with black eyes, hair, and rosy cheeks, adding that she was good and smart.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮透过苹果花丛凝望着戴安娜，急切地想要了解她的近况。她希望戴安娜不会像自己一样有红发。玛丽拉描述说戴安娜长着黑眼睛、黑头发和红润的脸颊，还说戴安娜是个品行端正且聪明的女孩。

paragraphs.en: Anne was delighted to be considered pretty. She longed for a beautiful best friend, much like she wished she could be beautiful herself. At Mrs. Thomas's house, Anne used to pretend that her reflection in a broken bookcase door was another little girl named Katie Maurice.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮很高兴被认为漂亮。她渴望有一个美丽的挚友，就像她希望自己也能美丽一样。在汤玛斯太太家，安妮常常假装镜子里破旧书架门中的倒影是另一个名叫凯蒂·莫里斯的小女孩。

paragraphs.en: They were very close, and Anne would talk to her every Sunday. The broken door symbolized the end of their imaginary friendship when Anne moved to Mrs. Hammond's.
paragraphs.zh: 她们关系非常亲密，安妮每个星期天都会和她交谈。那扇破旧的门象征着安妮搬到汉德姆太太家后，两人虚构友情的终结。

paragraphs.en: At Mrs. Hammond's, Anne found solace in an echo from a nearby green valley. She imagined it as a friend called Violetta, who became almost as dear to her as Katie Maurice. On the night before she entered the asylum, Anne said goodbye to Violetta, and the echo of their farewell echoed back with such sadness that it broke her heart.
paragraphs.zh: 在汉德姆太太家，安妮从附近绿色山谷的回声中找到了慰藉。她想象那声音是一位名叫维奥莱塔的朋友发出的，几乎和凯蒂·莫里斯一样让她感到亲近。在进入疗养院的前一晚，安妮向维奥莱塔告别，两人告别的回音带着如此深沉的悲伤，让她的内心受到了极大的触动。

paragraphs.en: Anne's imagination provided comfort but also pain, as she struggled to find a new bosom friend in the asylum.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的想象力既带给她安慰，也让她痛苦，她努力在疗养院里寻找新的知心朋友。

paragraphs.en: Marilla dryly stated, "It's better there wasn't. I don’t approve of such imaginings. You should have a real friend to dispel such nonsense. Don’t mention your Katie Maurices or Violettas to Mrs. Barry; she might think you tell stories."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉干巴巴地说道：“最好没有那种想象。我不赞成这种幻想。你应该有一个真正的朋友来驱散这些胡思乱想。别跟巴里太太提起你的凯蒂·莫里斯或维奥莱塔；她可能会以为你在说故事。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, I won’t," Anne replied. "Their memories are too sacred for that. But I wanted you to know about them.
paragraphs.zh: “不，我不会的。”安妮回答，“那些记忆太神圣，不能随便提起。但我希望你能知道这些事。”

paragraphs.en: Look, there’s a bee in an apple blossom! Imagine living and sleeping in such a place when the wind rocks it. If I were a bee, I’d love to live among flowers."
paragraphs.zh: 看，有一只蜜蜂停在苹果花上！想象一下，在微风摇曳中与花朵为伴生活和睡眠该有多美妙。要是我是一只蜜蜂，一定喜欢住在花丛中的。

paragraphs.en: Marilla sniffed, "Yesterday you wanted to be a seagull. You are very fickle. Learn that prayer and stop talking.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉哼了一声，“昨天你还想做海鸥呢。你真是喜新厌旧。快去学祈祷，别再胡说八道了。”

paragraphs.en: But if someone listens, you can’t stop. Go to your room and learn it well; stay there until I call for tea."
paragraphs.zh: 但是如果你被别人听见，那就无法阻止了。快回房间去好好记熟；待在那里，直到我叫你来喝下午茶。

paragraphs.en: Anne said, "I know the prayer almost all—just the last line." She pleaded, "Can I take the apple blossoms as company?" Marilla replied, "No, they don't belong in your room.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮说：“我知道那段祷词几乎全部内容——只是最后一句。”她恳求道：“能不能让我拿苹果花作伴呢？”玛丽拉回答说：“不行，它们不适合放在你的房间里。”

paragraphs.en: Leave them on the tree."
paragraphs.zh: 把它们留在树上。

paragraphs.en: Anne admitted, "I felt that way too. I didn’t want to shorten their lives by picking them. But the temptation was irresistible.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮承认：“我也这么觉得。我不愿意因为摘花而缩短它们的生命，但这种诱惑实在难以抗拒。”

paragraphs.en: What do you do when faced with such a temptation?"
paragraphs.zh: 面对这样的诱惑，你会怎么做？

paragraphs.en: After sighing, Anne went to the east gable and sat by the window in her room.
paragraphs.zh: 叹了一口气后，安妮走到东面的山墙旁，在房间的窗边坐了下来。

paragraphs.en: Anne stood before the small mirror, staring at her freckled face and solemn gray eyes. "You're only Anne of Green Gables," she said earnestly. "But it's much nicer to be Anne than some imaginary Lady Cordelia."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮站在小镜前，盯着自己满是雀斑的脸和深沉的灰色眼睛。“你只是绿山墙农舍里的安妮，”她认真地说，“但比起什么虚幻的科黛丽亚小姐，做真正的安妮要好得多。”

paragraphs.en: She leaned forward, kissed her reflection, then went to the open window. "Dear Snow Queen, good afternoon. And hello to the birches and the gray house on the hill."
paragraphs.zh: 她向前倾了倾身子，亲吻了一下镜中的自己，随后走到敞开的窗前。“亲爱的雪女王，下午好。还有，向山上的白桦树和那座灰色的房子问个好。”

paragraphs.en: She wondered if Diana would be her bosom friend. "I hope so," she thought, "and I'll love her very much."
paragraphs.zh: 她想知道戴安娜是否会成为她的知心朋友。“但愿如此，”她心想，“我会非常爱她的。”

paragraphs.en: Anne remembered Katie Maurice and Violetta. "I mustn't forget them," she said softly. "They'd feel hurt if I did."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮想起了凯蒂·莫里斯和薇奥蕾塔。“我可不能忘了她们，”她轻声说道，“如果忘了她们会觉得受伤的。”

paragraphs.en: She blew a few kisses to the cherry blossoms outside before sinking into a sea of daydreams.
paragraphs.zh: 她向窗外的樱花吹了几个吻，随后沉溺于无尽的幻想之中。
